summary: Reproduced an AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow in the x86 CPU topk_sigmoid_cpu correction-bias path for one expert. Partial SIMD loads and stores now bound accesses for float32 and reduced-precision inputs, with regression coverage for 1, 2, 4, and 8 experts.

tests.command: LD_PRELOAD=$(gcc -print-file-name=libasan.so) ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 <python> -c '<load ASan CPU common_ops and run the reported one-expert reproducer>'
tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, AddressSanitizer reported a 64-byte heap-buffer-overflow read in sigmoid<float, 1> at topk.cpp:181, immediately after a 4-byte gating_output allocation.

tests.command: LD_PRELOAD=$(gcc -print-file-name=libasan.so) ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 <python> -c '<exercise float32/bfloat16 x 1/2/4/8 experts x renormalize true/false>'
tests.what_was_measured: The rebuilt ASan native library completed 32 small-vector cases without a sanitizer finding and matched independent torch.sigmoid, torch.topk, gather, and normalization references.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python <python> -c '<load rebuilt release common_ops and run TestCustomTopK.test_topk_sigmoid_with_correction_bias_small_expert_counts>'
tests.what_was_measured: The added repository regression passed all float32/bfloat16, 1/2/4/8-expert, and renormalization boundary combinations.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python <python> -c '<load rebuilt release common_ops and run the existing correction-bias and mixed-input-dtype tests>'
tests.what_was_measured: The existing broad correction-bias matrix and mixed-input-dtype tests passed against the rebuilt native library.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported defect and changed operator are x86 CPU-only; no GPU result is relevant to the bounded host SIMD access.

remaining_limitations: Validation covers the standalone CPU operator, not a full model or serving workload.

The full registered test module could not be imported under AddressSanitizer because ROCm SMI triggered an unrelated libasan C++ exception-interceptor check; direct native operator sanitizer validation passed, and the registered regression passed against a separate non-ASan rebuild.
